mapping.summary: Stock visibility across companies, custom availability rules and low-stock email alerts.
claims: Colour-coded indicators on documents flag low and critical stock
User-defined availability formulas combining inventory, reservations, sales, purchases, production and transfers
Trading hub page for fast sales order creation showing prices and costs
One screen showing stock across all BC companies
Stock levels shown inside sales, purchase and production documents
Inventory views filtered to each user's own locations
Rotation report analyses sales and stock to suggest transfers between locations
Transfer orders created in one click from the rotation report
Low-stock email alerts with thresholds per item, category or global
Free unlimited testing in sandbox and one month free in production
Works with Essentials and Premium editions
